Join evolutionary astrologer Dabney Lawless as she discusses Chiron in Aries & Taurus and ways in which we can manage this energy! 

Bio- Dabney Lawless is an evolutionary astrologer with over 20 years of experience. Dabney currently hosts a YouTube podcast, Lawless Astrology, featuring interviews with prominent astrologers.

In the 2000's, she was the resident astrologer for Parents Magazine, Pregnancy & Newborn Magazine, and Working Mother. Her work has been featured on the Today Show and she has been published in Yogi Times, Pop Sugar, Bustle, People.com and on Astrology.com where she had a regular column.  

Dabney lives in Northern California with her husband, teenage son, three cats and five chickens. She is a member of the Organization of Professional Astrologers (OPA) and has completed the Center for Relationships and Astrology certification. www.lawlessastrology.com

items.title: October Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A detailed look at the astrology forecast for October 2026, with astrologer Chris Brennan. 

This month is dominated by a tumultuous Venus retrograde in Scorpio, kicking off alongside intense hard aspects to Mars and Pluto, which will dredge up some challenging things from the past.

Tensions are further heightened as Mercury slows down and stations retrograde in Scorpio later in the month, bringing communication breakdowns and the need for significant retooling.

I explore the historical precedents for these transits and break down how to navigate this tough astrological weather before the planets finally station direct and offer resolution in mid-November.

This is episode 551 of The Astrology Podcast.
